Name: Seasonal Magnus Rasmodius
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Mod Basics[/size][/b][/center]﻿
So here we go!  An updated, 1.6 compatible, largely vanilla friendly wizard portrait/sprite mod!.  I know I've got several older versions laying around and I'm leaving those up incase someone is using an older version of things... but this version is the best version... and has the coding to hopefully prove it.

[center][size=5][b]Installation [/b][/size][/center]
1. Unzip
2. place in mod's folder
3. Profit!
You will wanna remove my older/other mods for Ras, they will compete and that's less great.

[b][size=5][center]Compatibility issues[/center][/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Seasonal Cute Characters (normal and SVE):[/size][/b]  You'll have to turn the wizard off.  Also I don't have a no nose option...
[b][size=3]Romancing Rasmodius SVE version:[/size][/b]  You will need to check your configs on this.  I have set my mod up to use the LfL 12 portrait version with RomRas(SVE) but that portrait loadout does not have my green "Pink hair" version, So if you really want the pink haired version and you're using RomRas(SVE) you'll wanna pick your configs and portrait loadout accordingly.
[b][size=3]Looking for Love:[/size][/b] Not extensively tested, it seems to be working?  You might have to specify that the wizard is dateable and or futz with the config file on LfL. inconsistencies might occur. 
[b][size=3]RRRR:[/size] [/b] You will need to set your config to "Use included" instead of "Use Custom" then make sure my mod is below RRRR on your mod list.  This should happen naturally but if you're using folders it might not.  What's happening here is the beach sprites are only loaded in if you have "use included" up, so if you are on "Use Custom" and you hit a spicy scene the game looks for something that's not loaded and has an aneurism.

[b][size=5][center]Future plans[/center][/size][/b]
1. (DONE DUDES!)[s]Summer rain outfit!  Currently Ras is runnin round with his shoulder out (cus it's hot you know?) but if it's raining... that's silly.  Sadly that means having to change both portraits and sprites so it's not made yet. [/s]
2. Winter outdoor outfit!  Same as the rain, just need to think on what sort of distinction I might put on him going outside in winter.  It might just be gloves though?  Not sure.  Haven't put enough thought into it.
3. Seasonal wedding!  Currently Ras just wears a single suit.  I thought it might be nice to have seasonal suits for the wedding... But Clearly I didn't think that up?
4. More festivals.  It might be fun to think up what our Wizard might think he should wear to say... a Luau.
5. other settings.  I got a config file on here, may as well use it.  If you've got any ideas or requests, send them my way.

[size=5][b]Config stuff[/b][/size]

Hey so I forgot to specify what the Config stuff does!  SO!
[b][size=3]Scars[/size][/b]
﻿Options: True/False
﻿Default: False
﻿What's it do? This just toggles if he has the scars that are supposed to be there in RRRR.  They're pretty faint just FYI, well healed.
[b][size=3]Modest[/size][/b]
﻿Options: True/False
﻿Default: False
﻿What's it do? This is for those who don't like that Magnus runs around without his top.  Turn it to true to keep his shirt on and his arms in his sleeves come summer.
[b][size=3]Override[/size][/b]
﻿Options: False, 7, 9, 12, 32
﻿Default: False
﻿What's it do? This is strictly for overriding the number of portraits you're using when my auto detection fails.  Most users will not need to mess with this one.

[size=5][center][b]The Other Stuff[/b][/center][/size][b]
[size=3]Notes:  [/size][/b]So there is something I'd like to point out... Just because I think some of you would probably see it as a bug but it is actually intentional.  Our wizard here wears his event day clothes all day.  It seemed to me that (as a slightly socially inept creature) he wouldn't see any reason to change his clothes mid way through the day.  
My testing has not been particularly exhaustive, so please, feel free to notify me of any issues the mod is giving you!
[size=3][b]Support[/b][/size] is possible on my [url=http://Ko-fi.com/lynn_nexus]Ko-fi
[/url]I only post here so if you find this somewhere else, it ain't me.
